title: Kismet
tagline: Artists and collectors converge on kismet to create, collect and curate art
description: Kismet was incepted at Kismet Casa Rome during FarCon for our artist's in residence to have a place they can call home. We build Kismet alongside the artists we platform to ensure the best user experience. We also have no mint fee, cover gas and ARweave uploads to allow artists on Kismet to begin minting and earning ETH on Base without onramping.
how_its_made: Kismet is a client on top of In Process, a fork of Zora V2. Our goal is to continue building Kismet as a client to showcase what an onchain art gallery should look and feel like for other's to build their own clients as they see fit. We are focused on maintaining operational efficiency to remain sustainable so the art can live forever.
